endorsements.quote: Therefore, future studies should also assess the impact of AI assistance on end-user performance, in addition to reporting the standalone accuracy of the AI system.

unlisted_practices: Authors of AI diagnostic accuracy studies should report at least the minimum set of STARD-AI checklist items, covering dataset practices, the AI index test and its evaluation, and algorithmic bias and fairness.
Policymakers, regulators and industry partners should incorporate STARD-AI and complementary EQUATOR Network reporting guidelines in clinical AI product and policy assessments.
Journals should adopt STARD-AI as a reporting standard for AI diagnostic accuracy studies submitted for publication.
Researchers should disclose commercial interests, dataset and code availability, and whether AI outputs are stored, auditable and available for evaluation.
Researchers should obtain formal ethics committee approval for AI diagnostic accuracy studies or justify why it is not required.

screen.reason: STARD-AI is a reporting guideline/framework for studies evaluating the diagnostic accuracy of AI systems.
